author: Ashley Roberts
text: Very reliable, punctual, and reasonably priced!! Super sweet young man!! Tyler is the best!! Thank you!!

author: Blake taylor
text: They came out on Sunday and took care of our septic pumping needs. Devin was great and very knowledgeable and informed me of best practices of take care of our tank. After pumping the tank we noticed that it was backed  in the pipes so he was able to unclog the pipe as well. Service was great from the first call until the job was complete. I highly recommend them to anyone.

author: Linda Farrell
text: Poo-wee Septic Service is amazing local business with reasonable prices in Lancaster county. Tyler is a friendly outgoing, prompt gentleman explains in detail services, possible problems you may be experiencing and detecting if you have any problem with your septic system. If you need septic services be sure to give a call!!! You won’t be disappointed.

author: Brian Campbell
